description: This file defines a React component named PanelResizer that provides resizable and collapsible functionality for panels within a web application's UI. It manages user interactions such as dragging, double-clicking, and resize events to adjust panel dimensions dynamically.

classes.name: PanelResizer
classes.description: A React component that facilitates resizing and collapsing of a panel element through mouse interactions, handling events and dynamic style adjustments.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method to set up event listeners after the component mounts.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Lifecycle method to synchronize component state with React props so that the UI reflects current properties.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Cleanup method that removes event listeners before the component unmounts.

methods.name: setWidth
methods.description: Adjusts the width of the associated panel element, considering constraints and triggering callbacks if provided.

methods.name: setLeft
methods.description: Sets the left position style of the panel element.

methods.name: onDblClick
methods.description: Handles double-click events to toggle between collapsed and expanded widths.

methods.name: handleWidthEvent
methods.description: Calculates and applies width adjustments based on mouse drag events.

methods.name: handleLeftEvent
methods.description: Calculates and applies position and width adjustments based on mouse drag events for left-side panels.

methods.name: computeMaxWidth
methods.description: Computes maximum permissible width based on parent container constraints.

methods.name: handleResize
methods.description: Handles window resize events to recalculate panel dimensions.

methods.name: addInvisibleOverlay
methods.description: Adds an overlay during resizing to handle mouse events correctly over iframes.

methods.name: removeInvisibleOverlay
methods.description: Removes the overlay added during resizing operations.
